race.comment: MY CHARM (2) ran third in town two back over this trip then found the mile a bit sharp at Kembla last start when out of the placings. Genuine mare who is perfectly placed today to show her best. FREDDIE BASSETT (1) shared the lead into the straight then was too good last time out in a Class 1 over 2050m at Gosford. Getting up in the weights but he is a progressive four-year-old who has further improvement in store at just the fourth run of the campaign. ASTROGAZER (3) made it two wins from the last three outings when he got home by the barest margin over this course and distance 10 days ago. Stays on the same weight in this slightly tougher contest. Hard to fault in recent times. WAR RIBBON (5) has been easily accounted for in his two runs this prep, most recently at Rosehill over 2400m. Far better placed in this company and coming back a little in distance helps. POWERFUL PRAYER (8) meets ASTROGAZER 2kgs better for a 1.9 length defeat here last time. Cannot be ruled out.
